title: Three views of the experimental Arup tailless monoplane (Fig. 9)
description: Taped-in composite print of three photographs of the semi-circular-wing Arup tailless monoplane: a side view on the ground, an underside view lettered "THE ARUP INC." with registration "12894", and a front view in flight. The caption reads "Three views of an Experimental Arup tailless Monoplane." with photo number "34924 A.C.". Typed text above quotes Jane's All the World's Aircraft (1935) and gives specifications (span 22 ft, LeBlond engine, 86 mph).
